tagline: Debug a cluster from a teammate's terminal — scale and delete stay with you.
requirements: Install kubectl and configure a kubeconfig with access to your cluster. Helm is optional. Pinned package requires Node.js >=18.

tools.name: kubectl_get
tools.note: Reads Kubernetes resource state; use least-privilege kubeconfig credentials.

tools.name: kubectl_logs
tools.note: Reads application logs, which may contain secrets.

seo.description: Set up Kubernetes MCP sharing with MCPWire. Use the host kubeconfig, review tool access alongside RBAC, and configure a teammate’s MCP client.
